I have dry skin so the added hydration was a bonus for me. I also have acne prone skin and it didn't clog my pores or cause a breakout. This is perfect for everyday! Complimentary from MDSolarSciences.

This tinted sunscreen is awesome! The usual sunscreen scent is very light and nearly nonexistant. Although I received this complimentary from MDSolarSciences, I will continue to use the Tint and Tone SPF 50 cream in the future!
